# Gauntlet

A Muse agent skill that stress-tests an artifact before it ships: run a builder against a blind critic that only sees the artifact and an external quality bar — no context, no mercy. Iterations run on a fixed budget with mandatory verification evidence, and you can also score a finished artifact directly against the bar without the loop. Useful for docs, PRDs, proposals, and specs. No account, no API key, no network needed.
